builds.name: switch2mac's engine
builds.about: switch2mac's own engine: Performance mode, the preparing screen, the run-time shaders taken from the dump. Fastest on M1 and M2 so far.

builds.name: nxnative's engine
builds.about: Upstream nxnative with switch2mac's overlay and key-2 settings: its own Switch 2 shader translator and shared terrain tiles (less memory). Suits M3 and newer.

choose.why: Macs with less than 24 GB of memory: nxnative's build needs much less memory (switch2mac's grows past 20 GB in long sessions)
M3 and newer Macs run nxnative's shaders better
M1 and M2 Macs with 24 GB or more run switch2mac's build faster (about 58 fps against 47 on an M1 Max)
